conjecture: Q76 (Seed Q2, KL cell transport): for x_Q, y_Q in S_n with RSK insertion tableaux P1, P2 and common recording tableau Q, is the KL polynomial P_{x_Q,y_Q} a function of (P1,P2) alone when transported across a left cell (i.e. independent of Q)? Raw form false; refined form Q76-T' (Bruhat-comparable for all Q AND l(y_Q)-l(x_Q) constant in Q => P constant in Q) survives n<=7.

tree.approach: Wake 293 / PROVE 294 scoping (memory/questions/2026-11-13-prove294-scoping.md): compute fibres over Q at n<=7 with klfast.py (validated vs klperm.py on all 98407 pairs n=6), kill raw/naive transport forms, isolate a surviving refinement. Results proofs/scope294/q76t_s7_results.md.

children.approach: Raw transport: P_{x,y} as a function of (P(x),P(y)) at fixed Q.
children.reason: Bruhat comparability of (x_Q,y_Q) already varies with Q at n=3; among comparable pairs P varies with Q at n=5 (4 keys) and n=6 (74 keys).

children.approach: If x_Q <= y_Q for all Q then P_{x_Q,y_Q} is constant in Q.
children.reason: n=7: 14 violations among 376 all-Q-comparable keys, exactly the keys where l(y_Q)-l(x_Q) varies with Q. Example P1=((1,3,6),(2,4,7),(5,)), P2=((1,2,3),(4,5,6),(7,)): P ranges over {1, 1+q, 1+2q+q^2, 1+3q+q^2}. Independently re-verified by q76t_verify.py.

children.approach: Q76-T plus hypothesis l(y_Q)-l(x_Q) constant in Q => P constant in Q. Computed n<=7 (keys/nontrivial: n=4 11/0, n=5 30/0, n=6 106/2, n=7 362/8; 0 violations); all nontrivial P = 1+q with isomorphic Bruhat intervals. Weak evidence: only 10 nontrivial instances; n=8 separator owed.
